props.label: Contact
props.html:
Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Everything Hills Shire homeowners ask us most — answered straight.

Do you do both soft and hard landscaping?
Yes — both. Soft landscaping covers the living side (turf, garden beds, planting, mulch), and hard landscaping covers the built side (retaining walls, paving, driveways). Most yards need a bit of both, and we handle the lot in-house.
Which areas do you cover?
We’re based in The Hills Shire and cover the whole area — Castle Hill, Kellyville, Baulkham Hills, Bella Vista, Rouse Hill, Dural, Kenthurst, Glenhaven, Annangrove and every suburb in between. If you’re nearby and not sure, just ask.
Do you offer free quotes?
We do. Every quote is free and obligation-free — we come out, have a look at your place, talk through what you’re after, and give you a clear price. No pressure, no call-out fee.
How much does landscaping cost?
It depends on the job — a garden tidy-up is very different to a full backyard build with a retaining wall and new turf. We’ll give you an honest, itemised quote so you know exactly what you’re paying for before we start.
Do you remove and prune trees?
Yes. We handle tree removal, pruning and cutting, and we clean up and cart away the mess when we’re done. For anything larger or near power lines we’ll let you know the safest way to tackle it.
How many years’ experience do you have?
Over 15 years landscaping across The Hills Shire and Sydney’s north-west — so we know the local soil, slopes and conditions, and what actually lasts out here.

Get a free quote

Tell us about your yard and we’ll get back to you fast.

15+ years · Free & obligation-free · No call-out fee
